hook.name: MemeHookV4
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for RobinSeed graduated meme token pools that collects a configurable swap fee after each swap and routes creator proceeds either to a fee escrow (Mode 0: creator fees) or to a buyback-and-lock vault (Mode 1: buyback), while a protocol share is always sent to a designated recipient via FeeEscrow.
